documents.title: UW–Madison Guiding Principles for Generative AI in Teaching
documents.stance_why: The guidance tells instructors to set and explain their own policy ('a policy for the entire course, or ... specific instructions for individual assignments') and sets no university-wide permission or ban, so it delegates.
documents.summary: Teaching-center principles on equity, data protection, educational uses, adapting assessments, communicating with students, and handling suspected misconduct. They leave AI rules to instructors and advise against AI detectors.
